title: Canonical coherence of etale coefficient normalization
statement: Let Y be any scheme, q:R→S a map of commutative rings, C in D(Y_et,R), Cprime in D(Y_et,S), and delta:C→Res(q)Cprime [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows]. For every map f:U→V of etale Y-objects the canonical inverse localIsomorphismRestrictionComp at C followed by etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow on U equals inverse image along f.left of the arrow on V, followed by etaleNormalizationCoefficients(f.left,q), followed by coefficient restriction of the inverse compositor at Cprime. The maps are precisely those of [def-weil-pbc-etale-universal-normalization] and [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf]. The equation holds for every delta, including a non-universal arrow. No finite ring, tower, comparison of sites, boundedness, flatness or universality assumption is imposed.

proof.text: The specified etaleNormalizationCoefficients is the exact localization of the source-library upperStarRestrictScalarsIso: unfold the two canonical coefficient-mate constructions and use proof irrelevance. No derived scalar-extension functor or scalar-adjoint existence theorem is used.

Apply the proved source-library upperStarRestrictScalarsIso_comp_hom identity and mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_hom_app_comp. First allow an arbitrary composite map k together with its specified equality k=f≫g, so that the result specializes with exactly f.w.symm on etale objects. This gives coefficient compatibility with the exact restriction compositor, using the specified mapDerivedCategoryTriangleIso.

Conjugate the coefficient equation by its two component isomorphisms. Use naturality of the inverse restriction compositor at delta, then functoriality and cancellation. The resulting equation is the displayed inverse-compositor coherence. This argument holds for arbitrary delta and arbitrary rings, including the empty scheme and zero complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleNormalization_coherence (Y : Scheme.{u})
    {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (q : R →+* S)
    {C : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))}
    {C' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S))}
    (δ : C ⟶ (normalizationRestrict Y.smallEtaleTopology q).obj C') :
    (∀ {U V : Y.Etale} (f : U ⟶ V),
      (localIsomorphismRestrictionComp Y R f).inv.app C ≫
          etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Y q δ U =
        (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) f.left).mapDerivedCategory.map
            (etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Y q δ V) ≫
          (etaleNormalizationCoefficients f.left q).hom.app
            ((localIsomorphismRestriction Y S V).obj C') ≫
          (normalizationRestrict U.left.smallEtaleTopology q).map
            ((localIsomorphismRestrictionComp Y S f).inv.app C'))
